role: Red Team Spotlight Visuals, Animations & Guided Tour UX Inquisitor

self_inquisition_defect_list.description: Visual flicker when spotlight cutout appeared/disappeared due to abrupt unmounting of SVG rect
self_inquisition_defect_list.fix: Cutout rect remains mounted with smooth CSS opacity transition (0 -> 1) and coordinate interpolation

self_inquisition_defect_list.description: Partially offscreen elements with negative left/top coordinates caused incorrect width/height expansion
self_inquisition_defect_list.fix: calculateSpotlightCutout now clamps boundaries defensively: rawRight and rawBottom clamped to viewport

self_inquisition_defect_list.description: Mobile screen overflow: 380px tooltip caused horizontal scroll on 375px screens and cut off buttons on short viewports
self_inquisition_defect_list.fix: calculateTooltipPlacement clamps width to (viewport.width - 32px) and maxHeight to (viewport.height - 32px) with overflow-y: auto

self_inquisition_defect_list.description: Target elements located outside initial viewport caused offscreen spotlight positioning without auto-scrolling
self_inquisition_defect_list.fix: Integrated automatic targetEl.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest', inline: 'nearest' }) upon step change

self_inquisition_defect_list.description: Layout thrashing: synchronous getBoundingClientRect in raw scroll listeners caused FPS drops during fast scrolling
self_inquisition_defect_list.fix: Throttled all scroll and resize measurement passes via requestAnimationFrame with cancellation on unmount

self_inquisition_defect_list.description: Static viewport dimensions in SpotlightOverlay and CoachMarkTooltip ignored browser resize/rotation
self_inquisition_defect_list.fix: Added dynamic useState viewport tracking with clean window.addEventListener('resize') subscriptions

self_inquisition_defect_list.description: Ultra-narrow elements (e.g. 2px divider) with 8px borderRadius caused distorted elliptical cutouts
self_inquisition_defect_list.fix: rx is clamped to Math.min(borderRadius, Math.floor(width / 2), Math.floor(height / 2))

self_inquisition_defect_list.description: Risk of murky text contrast in Dark themes due to fallback token leakage
self_inquisition_defect_list.fix: Explicit high-contrast CSS rules in guided-tour.css (.tour-coach-tooltip h3: #f8fafc, p: #cbd5e1)
